title: Sean McVay: I look at Stetson Bennett, Ty Simpson as "2A, 2B"

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay: I look at Stetson Bennett, Ty Simpson as "2A, 2B"
sources.description: The Rams released a depth chart that shows Stetson Bennett as the team's second quarterback and first-round pick Ty Simpson as their third quarterback, but head coach Sean McVay said things are less clear cut than that would make it appear.
